adviceText:
## Confirmed diagnosis

The blocker is unchanged and valid. No evidence files exist, and all required entry-condition files remain missing. The source implementation should not be touched.

The root cause is not implementation quality; it is **attempt orchestration**. Piprd is consuming revision attempts despite an external prerequisite that cannot be satisfied while piprd is active.

## Best next action

### Do not launch attempt 4

Only two attempts remain. Attempt 4 should be gated on all of these existing:

```text
/tmp/sembla-host-real-move-20260726/before/run-1.time
/tmp/sembla-host-real-move-20260726/before/run-5.time
/tmp/sembla-host-real-move-20260726/after/run-1.time
/tmp/sembla-host-real-move-20260726/after/run-5.time
/tmp/sembla-host-real-move-20260726/profile/post-change-full-duration.sample.txt
```

Pause or mark the PRD blocked without decrementing attempts until this gate passes.

### Collect externally

After stopping piprd and other agent/build sessions:

```sh
/tmp/prd0004-collect-evidence.sh
```

If the host cannot be made quiet now, preserve the current workspace and defer PRD 0004 rather than weakening the protocol or exhausting attempts.

## Attempt 4 scope—only after collection

The next implementation agent should perform one class-level evidence fix using the complete corpus:

- Five before executions.
- Five after executions.
- One profiled after execution.
- All timing and contention calculations.
- Byte comparisons across primary CSVs, summaries, manifests, and final hashes.
- One evidence directory and one README status note.
- Final acceptance gates.

No evaluator, test, PRD, dependency, CUDA, IR, pooling, fusion, or scalar-representation changes are warranted.

## Failure handling

- Minimum run contended: reject and recollect externally.
- Output or manifest divergence: stop as a correctness failure.
- Missing/changed binary or input hash: rebuild before collection.
- Negligible or negative speedup: report honestly; it is permitted.
- Host still busy: remain blocked rather than measure.

The correct next revision is therefore conditional: **no attempt 4 until the external corpus exists**.
